ann.t: Press Release — Lancer Container Lines Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled "LANCER CONTAINER LINES LIMITED ANNOUNCES UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Lancer Container Lines Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
